import re

def parse_grid_after(text, marker):
 m=re.search(re.escape(marker)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',text)
 if not m: raise ValueError(marker)
 h,w=map(int,m.groups()); lines=text[m.end():].splitlines()[:h]
 g=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in lines]
 assert all(len(row)==w for row in g)
 return g
for i,u in enumerate(users[1:4],1):
 inp=parse_grid_after(u,f'Demo pair {i} input')
 out=parse_grid_after(u,f'Demo pair {i} output')
